description: Handles PDF datasheet indexing, SHA-256 deduplication, text chunking, vector embedding in ChromaDB, and synchronized SQLite PartVault storage.
author: Charon Librarian

autonomous_archivist_index.description: Parses, deduplicates, and embeds PDF datasheets into ChromaDB while linking metadata to SQLite PartVault.

file_path.description: Absolute or relative file path to target PDF datasheet.

mpn.description: Manufacturer Part Number associated with datasheet.

sha256_hash.description: Precomputed SHA-256 hash for deduplication check.

autonomous_archivist_search.description: Performs vector RAG query across indexed datasheet chunks with optional MPN filtering.

query.description: Technical specs, parameters, or questions to query.

mpn.description: Optional MPN filter to constrain vector search context.

n_results.description: Maximum number of vector text chunks to retrieve.
